name: Racist
overview: Scripture teaches that God shows no partiality and calls His people to love and treat strangers as their own, remembering their own history as strangers in Egypt (Leviticus 19:33-34; Deuteronomy 10:17). Believers are reminded that all humanity shares one Creator and Father, and thus must not act treacherously against one another (Malachi 2:10). Jesus commands His followers to love one another as He has loved them and to judge righteously rather than by outward appearances (John 7:24; 13:34), emphasizing a Christ-centered unity that rejects discrimination.
